{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Modules

|descr= Damage given vehicles.
{{Feature|informative|Regarding locality: if a hitpoint is defined,<br>{{Icon|localArgument|32}} [[setHitPointDamage]] is used. Else,<br>
{{Icon|globalArgument|32}} [[setDamage]] is used.}}

|s1= [logic, vehicles, isActivated] call [[BIS_fnc_moduleDamage]]

|p1= logic: [[Object]] - the logic. Possible [[setVariable]] parameter:
* "value": [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) wanted damage, in range 0..1
* "bodypart": [[String]] - (Optional, default "0") [[setHitPointDamage]] hitpoint name

|p2= vehicles: [[Array]] of [[Object]]s - list of vehicles

|p3= isActivated: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[true]]) if [[true]], the fuel is set

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] when done, even if ''isActivated'' equals [[false]]

|x1= <sqf>[myLogic, vehicle player, true] call BIS_fnc_moduleDamage;</sqf>

|seealso= [[setDamage]] [[setHitPointDamage]]
}}
